_spec: BANZA R²S² — the four fundamental principles
_status: NON-NORMATIVE. This file is the single declaration of the canonical set. It records the principles by which BANZA is designed; it does not impose a requirement on an implementation. What binds an implementation is identified by contracts/production/normative-manifest.json.

principles.meaning_en: Deterministic and correct under independent implementation, adversarial input and boundary conditions.
principles.meaning_pt: Comportamento determinístico e correcto perante implementações independentes, entrada adversarial e condições-limite.
principles.decision_question_en: Will independently built implementations still behave correctly and deterministically?
principles.decision_question_pt: Implementações construídas de forma independente continuam a comportar-se correcta e deterministicamente?

principles.meaning_en: Contains failures, preserves safe operation where possible and recovers deterministically without weakening protocol guarantees.
principles.meaning_pt: Contém falhas, preserva operação segura onde é possível e recupera de forma determinística sem enfraquecer as garantias do protocolo.
principles.decision_question_en: What happens when this component or dependency fails?
principles.decision_question_pt: O que acontece quando este componente ou dependência falha?
principles.boundary_en: Resilience preserves safe operation and deterministic recovery under failure; it never permits bypassing trust, authorization, integrity or other protocol invariants merely to remain available.
principles.boundary_pt: A resiliência preserva operação segura e recuperação determinística perante falhas; nunca permite contornar confiança, autorização, integridade ou outros invariantes do protocolo apenas para continuar disponível.

principles.meaning_en: Critical properties are enforced by construction and fail closed when they cannot be established.
principles.meaning_pt: As propriedades críticas são impostas por construção e fecham por omissão quando não podem ser estabelecidas.
principles.decision_question_en: Can failure, attack or fallback violate trust or protocol invariants?
principles.decision_question_pt: Uma falha, um ataque ou um recurso alternativo conseguem violar a confiança ou um invariante do protocolo?

principles.meaning_en: Uses the smallest mechanism sufficient to provide the required property.
principles.meaning_pt: Usa o menor mecanismo suficiente para fornecer a propriedade exigida.
principles.decision_question_en: Is this the smallest mechanism that provides the required properties?
principles.decision_question_pt: Este é o menor mecanismo que fornece as propriedades exigidas?

not_principles._why: Each of these is a conclusion reached by applying the principles to a concrete risk, or a property the protocol possesses. Promoting one to a fifth principle would turn a set of criteria into a list of slogans.
not_principles.decentralization_where_concentration_cre: a derived decision, never a principle
not_principles.protocol_structural_properties: what the protocol must possess — website/content/BANZA_REFERENCIA.md §3
not_principles.architectural_invariants: structural constraints the architecture may not violate — the Whitepaper's five

hierarchy: R²S² fundamental principles — the criteria by which decisions are made
protocol structural properties — what the protocol must possess
architectural invariants — constraints the architecture may not violate
normative requirements — what an implementation must do
layered assurance gates — whether any of it is actually demonstrated
